notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary Request Attribute Value Update service boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies object-instance and object-class request overloads, invalid handle rejection, request tags, provider callbacks, response reflection, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-instance and object-class Request Attribute Value Update services with FederateAmbassador provider and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador requestAttributeValueUpdate declarations and FederateAmbassador provideAttributeValueUpdate/reflectAttributeValues callbacks
